implemented.name: State amplitudes
implemented.meaning: The complex amplitudes of the same excitation in the fixed site basis.

implemented.name: Spectrum
implemented.meaning: The three energy levels of the Hamiltonian; not a position record.

implemented.name: Projector
implemented.meaning: The density matrix psi psi*, invariant under a common phase of psi.

implemented.name: Site weights
implemented.meaning: The probability weights on the left, middle and right sites.

implemented.name: Boundary
implemented.meaning: Weight accessible at the two endpoints of this finite chain.

implemented.name: Relative phase
implemented.meaning: Pairwise phases of conj(psi_i) psi_j, each undefined when its magnitude vanishes.

implemented.name: Coherence
implemented.meaning: Sum of absolute off-diagonal density-matrix entries in this specified basis.

implemented.name: Flow
implemented.meaning: Signed probability currents along the two bonds.

implemented.name: Propagation paths
implemented.meaning: A Taylor sum of weighted matrix walks predicts the next short step; a finite analogue of diagrammatic expansion, not QED Feynman rules.

implemented.name: Memory
implemented.meaning: Overlap with the initial ray; tracks recurrence of the specified preparation.

implemented.name: Resolution
implemented.meaning: Number of site weights meeting a fixed probability threshold; not directional packing or Gram spectral capacity.

implemented.name: Reflection
implemented.meaning: Expectation of the operator swapping the two endpoints.

implemented.name: Energy
implemented.meaning: Energy expectation and standard deviation under the stated Hamiltonian.

implemented.name: Influence
implemented.meaning: Forecast difference after increasing both bond couplings by ten percent, from the same current state.

implemented.name: Conservation
implemented.meaning: Norm and probability-continuity residuals across independently expressed equations.

implemented.name: Joint identification
implemented.meaning: Reconstruct the density matrix from populations and complex pair coherences; common phase is deliberately unidentifiable.

extensions.name: Non-Hermitian sensitivity
extensions.requirements: Requires a specified non-Hermitian operator and pairing; then use resolvent or pseudospectral data.

extensions.name: Entanglement
extensions.requirements: Requires a declared tensor-product split and reduced density matrix. Site Shannon entropy is not automatically this readout.

extensions.name: Loop return
extensions.requirements: Requires a parameter loop and a justified transport rule; gaps or singularities affect tracking.

extensions.name: Topological sector
extensions.requirements: Requires a base space, symmetry class and invariant with stated hypotheses.

extensions.name: Dissipation and work
extensions.requirements: Requires reservoirs, physical units and an energy balance.

extensions.name: Environment and backreaction
extensions.requirements: Requires a dynamical environment coupled both ways; the present Hamiltonian is fixed and has no such environment.

extensions.name: Change of scale
extensions.requirements: Requires a family of coarse-graining maps and error estimates between resolutions.

extensions.name: Experimental identification
extensions.requirements: Requires measured data, a noise model and an observability analysis; real-world causation requires more than correlated traces.

extensions.name: Cross-paper translation
extensions.requirements: Requires explicit maps preserving the declared pairings, readouts and units between different models.
